name: Holy Basil / Tulsi Ocimum tenuiflorum
summary: Holy basil is best framed for stress adaptation over time, not acute anxiety relief.
description: Holy basil is best framed for stress adaptation over time, not acute anxiety relief.
safetyNotes: FERTILITY/PREGNANCY CAUTION: Animal studies of holy basil (tulsi) have reported reduced implantation/pregnancy success with high doses. Human fertility and pregnancy effects have not been established; this is not proof of a human abortifacient effect. Avoid medicinal holy basil when pregnant or trying to conceive; breastfeeding safety has not been established. Holy basil may affect glucose, thyroid function and clotting; people using related medicines should consult a clinician.
contraindications: Pregnancy or attempting conception: avoid medicinal holy basil (animal reproductive signals; human effects unknown)
